request.style: English, warm female voice, solo with soft choir, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, flute, gentle mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai,
Speak to the people of Israel's line.
When you enter the land I give to you,
The land itself must keep the Sabbath true.
Six years sow the field and prune the vine,
Gather the produce in its season's time.
But in the seventh year let it rest,
A Sabbath of complete and holy rest.

[Chorus]
On the tenth day sound the ram's horn loud,
Proclaim liberty throughout the crowd.
Return to property and family's door,
The fiftieth year opens up once more.

[Verse]
Do not take advantage of neighbor's need,
Fear the Lord and keep His holy creed.
The land is mine and you are tenants here,
Redeem the property and draw near.
If a brother sells himself to you,
He is not a slave to do as you.
Treat him as a hired worker found,
Until the Jubilee year is found.

[Chorus]
On the tenth day sound the ram's horn loud,
Proclaim liberty throughout the crowd.
Return to property and family's door,
The fiftieth year opens up once more.

[Verse]
They are my servants from Egypt brought,
Not to be sold as slaves are caught.
Do not rule over them with harsh command,
Fear the God who gives you all the land.
Help the poor to live among the rest,
Do not charge interest on your chest.
I am the Lord who brought you out,
To give you Canaan as your fruit.

[Chorus]
On the tenth day sound the ram's horn loud,
Proclaim liberty throughout the crowd.
Return to property and family's door,
The fiftieth year opens up once more.

[Bridge]
The land will yield its fruit for three,
Eat from the old crop with such glee.
Securely live in the land you hold,
Faithful to the story God has told.

[Outro]
Proclaim liberty throughout the land,
In the hands of the Lord's own hand.
